subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with replacing, setting, and finding pixel colors in different locations?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What should the Palette sprite’s color parameter be set to, each time the for loop runs?


Solution:

6 should be replaced with paintColors[index] as the color parameter in the replace function inside the for loop.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What should the setPixel function’s parameters be set to so that a new pixel is set at the location of the Player sprite?


Solution:

The setPixel functions parameters should be replaced with (paintBrushSprite.x, paintBrushSprite.top, currentColor) in the onUpdate loop.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What should the currentColor be reassigned to when the Player sprite overlaps a Palette sprite?


Solution:

currentColor = otherSprite.image.getPixel(8, 8) should be added at the top of the onOverlap event.
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code to create a working project!


Each Palette sprite should display a different color from the paintColors array.


When the A button is pressed, a pixel should be set at the Player sprite’s position. The pixel color should update each time the Player sprite overlaps a Palette sprite.


Use the functions in the code menu and the code completion tool to create a working version of this project!

subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.failureText: Try rereading the instructions, then updating the code to create a working project.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 10 of Brown Belt! Before you create your final Brown Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 10:

badges.title: Extension Explorer
badges.description: Use the minimap, status bar, timer, and raycasting extensions to enhance a project.

badges.title: Bird’s Eye View
badges.description: Create and pin a minimap displaying a smaller representation of sprites and the tilemap in a corner of the screen.

badges.title: Gauging the Action
badges.description: Make something happen based on the value of a status bar.

badges.title: Wait for the Signal
badges.description: Use throttle to delay an action in a game.

badges.title: Right on Cue
badges.description: Run a chunk of code after a certain amount of time has passed.

badges.title: In-Depth Image
badges.description: Create a 3D version of a tilemap from a sprite’s perspective.

badges.title: Points of View
badges.description: Toggle between 3D and top-down views of a tilemap.
